title: TANTRA: The Rebel Path
author: Kimhye & Lucas
description: TANTRA: The Rebel Path is hosted by Kimhye Jin & Lucas Casanova and explores spirituality, yoga, meditation, and manifestation from a tantric perspective. You`ll get actionable insights and simplified tools to help transform your true potential, raise your vibration and elevate your consciousness to the next levels. Learn practical ways to cultivate your own spiritual practice; understanding the many laws of the universe and most importantly, how to keep your rebel soul intact on the journey. Get in touch: www.kimhye.com or www.lucascasanova.com Join a program: www.sky7.app or www.theshalayoga.com
